title: Input Group
description: An input with its addons attached: a prefix, a suffix, or a button sharing the same outline.
usage: One outline for the whole row: the group draws the seams, the Input part keeps its own focus ring. Text addons are for units and fixed prefixes (¥, https://); anything clickable should be a real button at the end.
a11y: The addon is decoration for the eye — the label and the placeholder must carry the unit on their own ("Amount in yen", not just "Amount"). Attached buttons are ordinary buttons with ordinary names.
